notes.title: Win a Rocking Pilot Steam key or a cool t-shirt !
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/emexsIG.jpg[/img]

In order to get these awesome goodies, you have to follow these easy steps:

1. Visit this link [url] https://gleam.io/vQGjA/rocking-pilot-giveaway [/url]
2. Download the Rocking Pilot demo
3. Answer five short questions.

And that's all!

Winners will be chosen from a random draw of entries on 9th August! Good luck!
